research_question: Can a frozen high-confidence or harmonic-consensus peak rule suppress small-lag separator artifacts while preserving exact-component physical accuracy?

candidate_rules.relative_0p75: earliest peak with score >= max(0.10, 0.75 * strongest score)
candidate_rules.relative_0p90: earliest peak with score >= max(0.10, 0.90 * strongest score)
candidate_rules.strongest: lag of the strongest autocorrelation peak
candidate_rules.harmonic_consensus: peak maximizing weighted support at integer multiples, with deterministic smallest-lag tie break

selection_rule.primary: maximize the minimum separated Pearson margin over the frozen regime limits

next_gate: If and only if one candidate passes, freeze it before generating any new identities; use new development and then two new independent confirmation seeds.
